data.one_liner: Load and cache SVG images from the network in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to easily load, cache, and display network SVG images with built-in placeholder support, error handling, fade-in animations, and cache management functions.
use_when: You need to display SVG images fetched from network URLs in your Flutter app.
You require automatic offline caching and placeholder/error states for SVGs.
avoid_when: You are only rendering local asset or memory-based SVGs.
You do not need caching functionality and can directly use flutter_svg.
strengths: Supports placeholders, error widgets, and custom fade durations.
Provides functions to pre-cache images and clear caches.
weaknesses: Adds an extra dependency layer over flutter_svg and flutter_cache_manager.

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need core SVG rendering capabilities without built-in network caching.

data.minimal_example:
CachedNetworkSVGImage(
    imageUrl: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/02/SVG_logo.svg',
    placeholder: const CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.green),
    errorWidget: const Icon(Icons.error, color: Colors.red),
    width: 250.0,
    height: 250.0,
    fadeDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
)
